headline: Argentina Sovereign Risk Spikes 110 Basis Points as Peso Weakens
summary: Argentina's JP Morgan country risk indicator rose by nearly 110 basis points while the retail exchange rate depreciated by 25 pesos on the week.
why: JP Morgan's EMBI index measures sovereign bond yield spreads over U.S. Treasuries, indicating country credit risk for international lenders.

impacts.name: USD/ARS
impacts.why: The U.S. dollar gained 25 pesos over the week in retail markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Argentina country risk spiked nearly 110 basis points as currency pressure intensified in domestic FX markets.
